reasonableness.revised_prompt:
Wide 16:9 fantasy fairy garden, locked high-angle three-quarter camera matching structure reference (same vanishing points, same path curve). Soft sculpted clay 3D render, Gardenscapes-level casual mobile polish, soft noon fill light from upper-left, pastel saturation, matte satin materials, no plastic oil shine, no neon, no readable text.

IDENTITY LOCK from character close-up (ignore her black-bg crop framing): young blonde fairy with two short braids tied with pink bands, pointed elf ears, large vivid GREEN eyes with catchlights (not blue/teal), rosy cheeks, soft friendly closed-mouth smile, pink short puffed-sleeve dress with white scalloped collar and three small white pearl buttons down the bodice, pearl necklace with one round turquoise-blue pendant, four translucent pale-blue leaf-veined wings, pink shoes, holding a small woven wicker basket of red apple, yellow lemon, purple grapes.

OFF STATE (idle): she stands quietly waiting on the center stone path in front of the purple-flower-roof mushroom cottage, feet planted on stones with contact shadows, body facing slightly toward camera, BOTH hands holding the basket still at waist/chest — NO waving arm, NO mid-air levitation, calm standby pose.

SCENE STRUCTURE LOCK from structure board: bottom-left glowing purple bell-flower lamp; bottom-right red-spotted mushroom table with cheese wedges and berries; left mid pond with banana-shaped yellow sailboat; winding irregular white flat stone path; right mole with black glasses holding pink and blue gift boxes; background purple-flower-roof cottage/mushroom house and snail-shell planter with white daisies and blue-spotted mushrooms; lush green grass and oversized plants. Remove or heavily de-emphasize the silver-haired violin male fairy so he does not steal focus.

Character anatomy continuous: shoulders-elbows-wrists, both eyes same height/direction, five fingers readable if visible, wings attached to back. Soft toy-like miniature garden scale with oversized flowers. Fail-at-glance if: waving pose, blue eyes, flat front camera instead of high three-quarter, missing mushroom-house garden anchors, plastic neon look, or text.

score_evidence.lighting_color: 角色额头、金发、翅膀及黄色船体上方有统一的柔亮高光，物体下方落有偏软阴影，粉、黄、绿、蓝色块区分清楚。
score_evidence.perspective_anatomy: 池岸石块、木桥和石径均以俯视角展示顶面并向后缩小，角色双脚稳定落在石板上；捧篮处手指与篮把的叠压略显拥挤。

score_evidence.spec_style: 人物、蘑菇屋、石块和水果都采用圆润体块、平滑材质与柔和高光，整体保持统一的卡通粘土式三维表现。
score_evidence.flawlessness: 主体轮廓和大多数遮挡关系干净，无文字或明显破面；篮把贴近右手腕、头发贴近翅根，前景花灯与果盘被边缘硬切，局部仍有轻微粘连和截断感。
